crimes.name: Shoplift
crimes.ok: I shoplifted a few things and walked out like I owned the place.
crimes.caught: I was caught shoplifting by a mall guard with a very small flashlight.

crimes.name: Burglary
crimes.ok: I burgled a house and left with a television and a sense of purpose.
crimes.caught: I was caught burgling a house while eating its cereal.

crimes.name: Grand Theft Auto
crimes.ok: I stole a car and sold it to a man named Dave.
crimes.caught: I was caught in a stolen car with a very loud radio.

crimes.name: Resisting arrest
crimes.ok: I resisted arrest and then un-resisted.

crimes.name: Assault
crimes.ok: I assaulted a man and he deserved it, mostly.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for assault after a very public punch.

crimes.name: Drunk driving
crimes.ok: I drove drunk and made it home.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for driving while very festive.

crimes.name: Drug dealing
crimes.ok: I sold drugs for a few weeks and made some money.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for selling drugs to a man in a trench coat, who was a cop.

crimes.name: Embezzle from work
crimes.ok: I embezzled from my employer and bought a boat I could not afford to tell anyone about.
crimes.caught: I was caught embezzling by an accountant with a long memory.

crimes.name: Rob a bank
crimes.ok: I robbed a bank in a rubber mask and escaped on a rented scooter.
crimes.caught: I robbed a bank and was caught in the parking lot trying to start a scooter.

crimes.name: Murder
crimes.ok: I killed a man and told nobody.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for murder and the evidence was a footprint and a note.

crimes.name: Hire a hitman
crimes.ok: I paid a man to take care of a problem. He did.
crimes.caught: I hired a hitman who turned out to be an undercover cop.

crimes.name: Extortion
crimes.ok: I extorted a local business owner and he paid on the first visit.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for extortion after a very clear voicemail.

crimes.name: Corruption
crimes.ok: I took a bribe from a developer and got a new dock.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for corruption after a reporter checked my dock.

crimes.name: Securities fraud
crimes.ok: I cooked the books and made the quarter.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for securities fraud, which was in the books.

crimes.name: Match fixing
crimes.ok: I fixed a match and bought a slightly better yacht.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for match fixing.

crimes.name: Defraud a casino
crimes.ok: I cheated a casino and left in a very good mood.
crimes.caught: I was arrested for defrauding a casino, and was banned for life.
